[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-9k[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Make %wait(priority=N) effective, observable, and editable[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A deprioritized agent (%wait with a priority above the default) [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]reliably yields runner-slot capacity to normal-priority work that [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]becomes runnable moments later, and the priority that decided a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]queue outcome is visible and editable from ACE.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase/repos/plans/202607/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]wait_priority.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bounded deference window for deprioritized waiters[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]deference[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'Bounded deference window for deprioritized waiters' section: add a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]priority-scaled, bounded hold-back gate so a below-default-priority [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]waiter does not claim a freshly freed runner slot while a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]better-priority agent is still finishing its dependency wait, with an [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]early exit when no such agent exists.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]wait_priority_explicit marker symmetry[/bold #D7AFFF]                        [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]explicit-flag[dim] · [dim][/dim]after deference[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]"'wait_priority_explicit marker symmetry' section: record whether a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]parked agent's priority was user-specified or defaulted, mirroring [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]wait_runners_explicit, so a marker written with the implicit default no [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]longer shadows a later directive change."[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Surface wait priority in ACE[/bold #D7AFFF]                                  [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]ace-display[dim] · [dim][/dim]after explicit-flag[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'Surface wait priority in ACE' section: render the explicit wait [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]priority (and deference state) on queued agent list rows and in the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]agent detail pane's Wait line, including the render-cache key fix.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Edit wait priority from the ACE wait modal[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]wait-modal[dim] · [dim][/dim]after explicit-flag[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]'Edit wait priority from the ACE wait modal' section: add a priority [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]field to the ACE wait modal and its directive/marker persistence path, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and make sure editing other wait fields never clobbers an existing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]wait_priority.[/#D7D7AF]
